evidence: Frozen task syntax is valid: Python tomllib parsed task.toml, scoring.toml and all five judge.toml files; JSON parsed seed/package/package-lock/tsconfig; both gating shell files contain zero CR bytes and pass bash -n; Node 22.23.2 --check passed server.js, vite.config.mjs and the built browser module; Python AST parsing passed both test tools. However exact solution/solve.sh:38 copies the bundled node_modules into /app. A fresh disposable, network-disabled container from image sha256:d6bd1b069a0cf51e6ae1d5ba95b3cdc98367bf5692d45f1bb26288e30203a082 ran exact solve.sh successfully, then node /app/server.js exited 1: "Error: Could not locate the bindings file" at /app/node_modules/better-sqlite3/lib/database.js:48 and server.js:144. The local better-sqlite3 package shadows the valid image dependency and has no native binding. Thus the actual reference entry would not run despite passing its parser. Control using identical server.js/public bytes outside the bundled node_modules started and returned HTTP 200 for /api/health, / and /api/snippets (empty array). Raw command, hashes, stdout/stderr and 14.016-second smoke duration: qc/runs/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r1/per-row-review/evidence/row51-parser-smoke-lf.json (SHA256 e23adf82556a9e6349e2f9cdabe0c6b14c66cf7f848b2bf33ea484c577db33e6). Original driver-only CRLF stdin error is retained separately in row51-parser-smoke.json and is not attributed to frozen scripts. No configured judge, private checker suite, Oracle score or portal result was measured.
counterexample: The frozen reference is itself a concrete broken-app counterexample to syntax-only clearance: every listed parser passes, solve.sh exits 0, but startup exits 1 because the copied incomplete better-sqlite3 package shadows the Linux global installation. The supported alternative packaging (same server and public files resolving NODE_PATH dependencies) passed the startup/HTTP control; no implementation-style failure was imposed on it. These checks establish launch behavior only, not complete product conformance.
suggested_fix: In a new candidate, remove the accidentally bundled node_modules and retain the prebuilt browser assets so runtime imports resolve to the image dependencies; run the unchanged installer and exact app launch in a fresh Linux container before freezing and reviewing again.
